review.narrow_shared_operation_and_contract: Export the selected plan through different destinations.
review.rationale: Copy writes raw planMarkdown to clipboard and manages transient UI state. Download builds a filename, normalizes markdown for export and downloads a file. Shared input and null guard do not establish a common output contract.
review.legitimate_variations: Clipboard feedback/lifecycle versus filename, normalization and file download are substantive differences.
review.existing_shared_owner_or_delegation: Download delegates filename/export/file creation to imported helpers; no common destination operation is demonstrated.
review.uncertainty_and_disagreement: Helper bodies are not supplied here; classification rests on explicit calls and their arguments.
